DILG Republic of tho Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILGAAPOLCOM center, EDSA corner Avenue, west Triangle, Ouezon City http: //www dilg.conl.ph DILG OPINION No. 54 s. 2023 HON. MARITES K. PALLASIGUE Mayor, Municipality of Isulan Province of Sultan Kudarat Dear Mayor Pallasigue: This has reference to your three (3) letters to the Department regarding your present predicament in your Municipality. Based on your letters, you are on your 3rd term as Mayor of Isulan, Sultan Kudarat. It appears that administrative cases docketed as 16-01-2023, 16-03-2023 and 16-04- 2023 were filed against you by Vice-Mayor Arnold H. Aramada, et al. before the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, On June 26, 2023, a 60-day preventive suspension order was served upon you by Governor Pax Ali S. Mangudadatu. Counting from June 26, 2023, said preventive suspension will end on August 25, 2023. Meantime, the 2023 Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections was scheduled on October 30, 2023. Per COMELEC Resolution No. 109051, election period was set from August 28, 2023 to November 29, 2023. In your July 25, 2023 letter, which we received on July 27, 2023, you asked the Department's clarification on this issue: "In the absence of a prior approval from Comelec, will the Order Of Preventive Suspension imposed upon me (Mayor Pallasigue) by Honorable Provincial Governor Datu Pax Ali SL. Mangudadatu on June 26, 2023 be automatically lifted on August 1, 2023, which is 90 days before the 2023 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections scheduled on 30 October 2023 by virtue of Section 62 (c) of the R.A. 7160 or the Local Government Code? In your letter dated August 3, 2023, you manifested that since August 1, 2023, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Sultan Kudarat has been conducting investigations in relation the administrative complaints against you that are pending before said august body. For this, you are asking clarification on these additional issues: 1 Entitled "REVISED CALENDAR OF ACTIVITIES AND PERIODS OF CERTAIN PROHIBITED ACTS IN CONNECTIONS WITH THE OCTOBER 30, 2023 SYNCHRONIZED BARANGAY AND SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN ELECTIONS (BSKE)'. "Matlno, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No,: 8876-34-54

2. 3. Is the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Sultan Kudarat prohibited from conducting any investigation from the start of 90-day period before the October 30, 2023 local election which ensued on August 1, 2023 until the day of the elections pursuant to Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991? Can the Sangguniang Panlalawigan in the alternative invoke the commencement of the election period set by the COMELEC which is set on August 28, 2023 as the beginning Of the prohibition for the conduct of any investigation in relation to the administrative charges against me, and therefore still schedule the conduct of such investigations on dates inclusive from August 02, 2023 until August 27, 2023? Should an investigation have already commenced prior to the 90-day period before election mentioned in Section 62 (c), which is the instant case falls on August 01 , 2023, can the Sangguniang Panlalawigan still continue with the conduct of such when the said period articulated in the aforementioned Section has ensued, or will the arrival of the same date suspend the investigation which has already started prior therefrom? In your letter dated August 4, 2023, you represented that by virtue of Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991 and DILG Legal Opinion No. 51, series of 2023, you wrote the Governor on August I, 2023 indicating therein your intent to resume your post, as in fact you already resumed office on August 1, 2023. However, on August 2, 2023, the Governor denied your resumption to office and that the Vice-Mayor continued as Acting Mayor. For this, you are asking the Department to issue a Certificate of Recognition to your favor. Since the issues you have raised are interrelated, we deem it proper to respond to them in a single discussion. At the outset, may we invite your attention to the following provisions of law: 1) Section 62 of the Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC), thus: "SECTION 62. Notice of Hearing. - (a) Within seven (7) days after the administrative complaint is filed, the Office of the President or the Sanggunian concerned, as the case may be, shall require the respondent to submit his verified answer within fifteen (15) days from receipt thereof, and commence the investigation of the case within ten (10) days after receipt of such answer of the respondent. (b) When the respondent is an elective official of a province or highly urbanized city, such hearing and investigation shall be conducted in the place where he renders or holds office. For all other local elective officials, the venue shall be the place where the Sanggunian concerned is located. (c) However. no investigati0Q shall be held within ninety (90) days immediatelv prior to anv local election. and no preventive suspension 9haIl be Imposed within the said period. If preventive suspension has been imposed prior to the 90.day period Immediately precedinq local election. it Shal! be deemed automaticallv lifted ypon the start of Pforesaid period." (Emphasis Supplied) page 2 of 6

2) Section 261 (x) of the Omnibus Election Code, thus: "Sec. 261. Prohibited Acts. - The following shall be guilty of an election offense: xxxx (x) Suspension of elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay officer. - The provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding during the election period, any public official who suspends, without prior approval of the Commission, any elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay officer, unless said suspension will be for purposes of applying the "Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act" in relation to the suspension and removal of elective Officials; in which case the provisions of this section shall be inapplicable. Two (2) periods were mentioned in the aforequoted provisions, to wit: I) Election period vis-å-vis the upcoming October 30, 2023 Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SBSK) Elections, which per COMELEC Resolution No. 109052 was set from August 28, 2023 to November 29, 2023; and 2) 90-day period immediately preceding local election mentioned in Section 62 (c) of the LGC. To better understand the effects of these periods, we made an illustration as follows: August 1, 2023 Election period October 30.2023 (Election Day) August 28, 2023 90-day period per sec. 62 LGC November 29, 2023 Based on the foregoing, we clarify that: • Starting August l, 2023 up to October 29, 2023 [90-day period contemplated under Section 62 (c) of the LGCl—The sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan and the Office of the President can no longer impose preventive suspension upon local elective officials. 2 Entitled •REVISED CALENDAR OF ACTIVITIES AND PERIODS OF CERTAIN PROHIBITED ACTS IN CONNECTIONS WITH THE OCTOBER 30, 2023 SYNCHRONIZED BARANGAY AND SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN ELECTIONS (BSKE)". page 3 of 6

If the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan or the Office of the President had imposed preventive suspension upon local elective officials prior to August I, 2023 and will last thereafter, such preventive suspension shall be deemed automatically lifted on August I, 2023 [onset of the 90-day period under Section 62 (c) of the LGCI. Let it be noted that Section 62 (c) of the LGC categorically states that the lifting of the preventive suspension 90 days immediately preceding local election shall be "automatic" hence, without need of any further issuance for this purpose. Let it be noted further that Section 62 (c) of the LGC governs only those preventive suspensions imposed by the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan and the Office of the President. It is inapplicable to the preventive suspension imposed by the Office of the Ombudsman and the Sandiganbayan, which are guided by different laws, rules and regulations as the Ombudsman Act and the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act. As regards suspension as a penalty, Section 62 (c) of the LGC only mentioned about the prohibition on the imposition of preventive suspension and does not include suspension as a penalty. Hence, suspension as a penalty may still be imposed by the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan and the Office of the President notwithstanding the onset of the 90- day period on August 1, 2023. As to the difference of suspension as a preventive measure and suspension as a penalty, the case of Quimbo vs. Gervaci03 is instructive, thus: "Preventive suspension is merely a preventive measure, a preliminary step in the administrative investigation. The purpose of the suspension is to prevent the accused from using his position and the powers and prerogative of his office to influence potential witnesses or tamper with records which may be vital in the prosecution of the case against him. If after such investigation, the charge is established and the person investigated is found guilty of acts warranting his suspension or removal, then he is suspended, removed or dismissed. This is the penalty." • Starting August 1, 2023 up to October 29, 2023 [90-day period contemplated under Section 62 (c) of the LGCI„ No administrative investigation shall be conducted by the Office of the President, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the Sangguniang Panlungsod and the Sangguniang Bayan, in the exercise of their jurisdiction to take cognizance of administrative complaints against elective local officials within their respective disciplinary authorities. The conduct of administrative investigation against local elective officials is not among the enumerated prohibited activities during the election period under Section 261 (x) of the Omnibus Election Code. The prohibition on the conduct of administrative investigation against local elective officials is found only under Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code, However. since the 90-day period under the Local Government Code is the first period to set in vis-å-vis the election G.R. No. 155620. August 9, 2005. page 4 of 6

period (refer to the illustration above), all investigations by the Office of the President and the local sanggunians which have quasi-judicial function must be halted at the onset of the 90-day period, which in the case of the 2023 SBSK Elections falls on August 1, 2023. Accordingly, the running of the period within which the investigating body should conduct the investigation is interrupted by the onset of the 90-day period under the Local Government Code. The running of the said period will resume (investigation may be conducted) after the October 30, 2023 SBSK Elections and there is no need to await the end of the election period since the conduct of administrative investigation is not a prohibited act during election period; Starting August 28, 2023 to November 29, 2023 (election suspension and suspension as a penalty imposed by the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan, the Office of the President, and the Office of the Ombudsman cannot be implemented without prior approval from the COMELEC pursuant to Section 261 (x) of the Omnibus Election Code. Otherwise stated, preventive suspension and suspension as a penalty imposed by the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan, the Office of the President, and the Office of the Ombudsman may still be implemented provided that they seek first the approval of COMELEC pursuant to Section 261 (x) of the Omnibus Election Code. Such COMELEC approval can be obtained by filing a request for exemption from the ban together with other supporting documents required. Let it be noted that Section 261 (x) did not mention about automatic lifting at the onset of election period of preventive suspension or suspension as a penalty earlier imposed. It only contemplates about the prohibition of implementation of preventive suspension or suspension as a penalty without COMELEC approval within said period. • Notwithstanding the onset of the 90-day period prior to the 2023 SBKE Elections and election period on August 28, 2023—suspension as a penalty or preventive suspension not pursuant to the Local Government Code of 1991 already being served (e.g. preventive suspension imposed by the Office of the Ombudsman and Sandiganbayan) shall not be deemed lifted. Applying the foregoing rules to your case, since the preventive suspension implemented upon you on June 26, 2023 was imposed by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the rule under Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991 therefore applies. Come August 1, 2023 (the onset of the 90-day period under the Local Government Code of 1991 is automatically lifted. To reiterate, the word "automatic" means that no further issuance or overt act is necessary to cause the lifting. As regards the conduct of administrative investigations within the 90-day period prior to the SBSK Elections, as comprehensively discussed above, the same is prohibited at whatever stage. The members of the sanggunians who still proceed to conduct the administrative investigation notwithstanding the clear prohibition under Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991 will be opening their selves to administrative cases. Page 5 of 6

We hope to have sufficiently guided you on these issues. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: Und N TOR R.
